strings.text: Distinct Upper School course entries in the school’s own current curriculum guide. Counting conventions differ — Country Day’s index bundles language levels onto one line, so its true course count is higher than the line count shown.
strings.t: Kantite kou Upper School diferan ki nan gid kourikoulòm aktyèl lekòl la li menm. Konvansyon konte yo diferan — endèks Country Day a mete nivo lang yo ansanm sou yon sèl liy, kidonk vrè kantite kou li genyen an pi wo pase kantite liy ki parèt la.

strings.text: Counted by course entry from the 2026-2027 Curriculum Guide: 196 coded entries plus 3 CPCC dual-enrollment entries. An entry listed under two codes (Academic Skills, 508 and 509; AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics, 953/954) counts once, while the two AP English 12 courses carry their own codes (243, 244) and count as the two entries they are; the prior-year guide listed 183.
strings.t: Konte pa antre katalòg apati Curriculum Guide 2026-2027 la: 196 antre ki gen kòd plis 3 antre enskripsyon doub CPCC. Yon antre ki gen de kòd (Academic Skills, 508 ak 509; AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics, 953/954) konte yon sèl fwa, alòske de kou AP English 12 yo pote pwòp kòd yo (243, 244) epi yo konte kòm de antre jan yo ye a; gid ane anvan an te liste 183.

strings.text: About 135 unique course titles; 6 of them are cross-listed in two departments, so a department-by-department tally would count those twice.
strings.t: Anviwon 135 tit kou inik; 6 nan yo make nan de depatman anmenmtan, konsa yon dekont depatman pa depatman ta konte sa yo de fwa.

strings.text: Counted as level-qualified entries across the nine department tiles the school publishes on its own High School academics page — a title offered at CP, Honors and AP counts once per level, matching how the other schools’ catalogs list courses. The older 2026–27 High School Profile course matrix showed 80.
strings.t: Konte kòm antre ki kalifye pa nivo nan nèf tuil depatman lekòl la pibliye sou pwòp paj akademik High School li a — yon tit yo ofri nan CP, Honors ak AP konte yon fwa pa nivo, menm jan katalòg lòt lekòl yo liste kou yo. Ansyen matris kou High School Profile 2026–27 la te montre 80.

strings.text: 74 courses are described in the 2026–27 catalog, with one more (AP Spanish Literature) listed without a description. The school’s own offerings grid shows 66.
strings.t: 74 kou dekri nan katalòg 2026–27 la, ak youn anplis (AP Spanish Literature) ki make san deskripsyon. Griy òf lekòl la li menm montre 66.

strings.text: Distinct course entries, with multi-year language sequences counted once per track rather than once per level.
strings.t: Antre kou distenk, ak sekans lang plizyè ane konte yon fwa pou chak filyè olye yon fwa pou chak nivo.

strings.text: High-school catalog only; the school publishes no named lower- or middle-school course lists. A subject taught at Standard, Honors and AP is counted as separate titles, matching how the school lists them.
strings.t: Katalòg lekòl segondè sèlman; lekòl la pa pibliye okenn lis kou ki gen non pou lower oswa middle school. Yon matyè yo anseye nan nivo Standard, Honors ak AP konte kòm tit apa, sa ki matche ak fason lekòl la liste yo.

strings.text: Counted from the school’s own 92-page 2026-2027 Course Selection Catalog. A subject taught at College Preparatory, Honors and AP counts once per level, matching how the catalog lists them and how the other schools here are counted. The catalog holds 177 course records and 117 distinct title strings, but its Comprehensive List of Electives re-lists courses already filed under their home departments, and five of those re-listings differ only in spelling — so 112 is the count of real courses.
strings.t: Yo konte l apati Katalòg Seleksyon Kou 2026-2027 lekòl la, ki gen 92 paj. Yon matyè yo bay nan nivo College Preparatory, Honors ak AP konte yon fwa pou chak nivo, jan katalòg la liste yo epi jan yo konte lòt lekòl yo isit la. Katalòg la gen 177 fich kou ak 117 tit diferan, men Comprehensive List of Electives li a reliste kou ki deja klase anba depatman yo, epi senk nan repetisyon sa yo diferan sèlman nan òtograf — konsa 112 se kantite kou reyèl yo.

strings.text: Share of AP exams scoring 3 or higher, most recent reported year. Davidson Day & Hickory Grove Christian do not publish a per-exam pass rate.

strings.text: 94% of 1,184 AP exams scored 3 or above in 2026 (22 subjects, 393 students); 76% scored 4 or 5. AP exams are mandatory in every AP course at CCHS, so this is a whole-cohort rate and cannot be flattered by weaker candidates skipping the exam.

strings.text: About 90% scored 3 or higher in May 2026 (the school reports 90.16% of students with scores 3+; 195 students, 446 exams). A score of 3+ is the level most colleges treat as a passing result.
strings.t: Anviwon 90% te jwenn 3 oswa plis nan mwa me 2026 (lekòl la rapòte 90.16% elèv ki gen nòt 3+; 195 elèv, 446 egzamen). Yon nòt 3+ se nivo pifò kolèj konsidere kòm yon rezilta ki pase.

strings.text: 96% of AP exams scored 3 or higher in 2026 (179 students took 401 exams; every AP student must sit the exam). A score of 3+ is the level most colleges treat as a passing result.

strings.text: Computed, not published: 336 seniors in the Class of 2027 divided by the six counselors named on the 2026-27 school profile, including the Director of Counseling Services. Across all four grades (~1,171 students) it is roughly 195:1.

strings.text: COMPUTED, not published — the school states neither a caseload nor a ratio. 35 seniors in the Class of 2026 over two college-counseling staff (Peter Gangemi, Director; Kristy Smith, Assistant) gives ~18:1; counted against the Director alone it would be 35:1.
strings.t: KALKILE, se pa pibliye — lekòl la pa deklare ni yon chaj travay ni yon rapò. 35 elèv finisan nan Class of 2026 la sou de manm pèsonèl konsèy inivèsite (Peter Gangemi, Director; Kristy Smith, Assistant) bay ~18:1; konte kont Director la sèlman li ta 35:1.

strings.text: About 26 seniors per dedicated college counselor at peak application season — 105 seniors across 4 counselors. A lower ratio means more counselor time per student.

strings.text: An effective caseload of about 55 seniors per college counselor at peak application season. A lower ratio means more counselor time per student.

strings.text: About 38 seniors per college counselor at peak application season — 151 seniors in the 2026–27 class across 4 counselors (computed; the school publishes no ratio). A lower ratio means more counselor time per student.

strings.text: 85 seniors against one dedicated Guidance & College Counseling Director — the heaviest caseload here, cushioned by a second guidance counselor and a guidance assistant who carry the non-college load. A lower ratio means more counselor time per student.

strings.text: Won Best Show at the Wells Fargo Blumey Awards for its production of Oklahoma! (2013). The Blumeys are the Charlotte region’s high-school musical-theatre awards.
strings.t: Te genyen Best Show nan Wells Fargo Blumey Awards pou pwodiksyon Oklahoma! li a (2013). Blumey yo se prim teyat mizikal lekòl segondè rejyon Charlotte a.

strings.text: 31+ nominations at the Blumey Awards, the Charlotte region’s high-school musical-theatre awards — a breadth-of-recognition figure rather than a single win.
strings.t: 31+ nominasyon nan Blumey Awards yo, prim teyat mizikal lekòl segondè rejyon Charlotte a — yon chif etandi rekonesans olye yon sèl viktwa.

strings.text: Over 80% of students take part in the arts — a participation measure the school leads with, alongside individual Blumey wins (Best Actress, 2022).
strings.t: Plis pase 80% elèv patisipe nan atistik — yon mezi patisipasyon lekòl la mete devan, ansanm ak viktwa Blumey endividyèl (Best Actress, 2022).

strings.text: Two wins at the Blumey Awards — Best Featured Performer (2013) and the Student Critic Award (2016) — within eight recognitions from 2013–2019, plus a 2025 National Shakespeare Competition finalist. The Blumeys are the Charlotte region’s high-school musical-theatre awards.
strings.t: De viktwa nan Blumey Awards yo — Best Featured Performer (2013) ak Student Critic Award (2016) — nan uit rekonesans depi 2013–2019, plis yon finalis National Shakespeare Competition 2025. Blumeys yo se prim teyat mizikal lekòl segondè rejyon Charlotte a.

strings.text: Repeated recognition at the Blumey Awards, the Charlotte region’s high-school musical-theatre awards.
strings.t: Rekonesans repete nan Blumey Awards yo, prim teyat mizikal lekòl segondè rejyon Charlotte a.

strings.text: The 2026 Blumey Award for Best Actress — Anna Jernigan, for Footloose. The winner advances to the national Jimmy Awards.
strings.t: Blumey Award 2026 pou Best Actress — Anna Jernigan, pou Footloose. Moun ki genyen an avanse nan Jimmy Awards nasyonal yo.

strings.text: Blumey Award nominees and finalists in back-to-back seasons — Seussical (2025) and Disney’s The Little Mermaid (2026), with Amara Aghedo and Christian Young recurring. No outright win is published. The Blumeys are the Charlotte region’s high-school musical-theatre awards.
strings.t: Moun ki gen nominasyon ak finalis Blumey Award nan de sezon youn dèyè lòt — Seussical (2025) ak Disney’s The Little Mermaid (2026), ak Amara Aghedo ak Christian Young ki repete. Pa gen okenn viktwa nèt ki pibliye. Blumeys yo se prim teyat-mizikal lekòl segondè rejyon Charlotte la.

strings.text: AP Studio Art is the only AP arts course CCHS offers — there is no AP Music Theory and no AP Art History, confirmed by sweeping all 199 courses in the curriculum guide. Reporting the AP count alone would make a 39-course department, the largest in the school, read as thin.
strings.t: AP Studio Art se sèl kou atistik AP CCHS ofri — pa gen AP Music Theory ni AP Art History, sa nou konfime lè nou pase nan tout 199 kou ki nan gid kourikoulòm nan. Rapòte dekont AP a pou kont li ta fè yon depatman 39 kou, pi gwo nan lekòl la, parèt mens.

strings.text: Visual Art IV (H) is the terminal arts course. There is no AP Studio Art or AP Art History in the profile's course table, so the ceiling here is an Honors course carrying +0.50 rather than an AP carrying +1.0.
strings.t: Visual Art IV (H) se kou atistik final la. Pa gen AP Studio Art ni AP Art History nan tablo kou pwofil la, kidonk plafon an isit la se yon kou Honors ki pote +0.50 olye ke yon AP ki pote +1.0.

strings.t: Kou atistik avanse nòt la site a se AP Studio Art.

strings.text: Offers both AP and IB arts pathways — a dual AP/IB arts offering that is rare among these schools.
strings.t: Ofri ni chemen atistik AP ni IB — yon òf atistik doub AP/IB ki ra pami lekòl sa yo.

strings.text: AP Studio Art tops the visual path (Intro to Art → Art 2/3 → Honors Studio Art → AP Studio Art); Honors Auditioned Theatre is the performing-side advanced course.
strings.t: AP Studio Art anlè chemen vizyèl la (Intro to Art → Art 2/3 → Honors Studio Art → AP Studio Art); Honors Auditioned Theatre se kou avanse sou bò pèfòmans lan.

strings.text: Three AP arts courses: AP Studio Art, AP Art History, and AP Music Theory.
strings.t: Twa kou atistik AP: AP Studio Art, AP Art History, ak AP Music Theory.

strings.text: Two AP arts courses, AP Art History and AP Art & Design, over nine Honors Fine Arts courses on the school’s 2026–27 profile: Acting Studio, Art III, Broadcasting, Upper School Choir, Digital Design and Animation II, Digital Music II, Jazz Band, Orchestra and Wind Ensemble.
strings.t: De kou atistik AP, AP Art History ak AP Art & Design, anlè nèf kou Honors Fine Arts ki sou pwofil 2026–27 lekòl la: Acting Studio, Art III, Broadcasting, Upper School Choir, Digital Design and Animation II, Digital Music II, Jazz Band, Orchestra ak Wind Ensemble.

strings.t: Kou atizay avanse lekòl la nonmen an se AP Studio Art 2D (AP 2-D Art & Design), anlè sekans estidyo Art I–IV la; elèv yo "consistently score 3 or 4."

strings.text: The program is organized around three pillars — Visual Arts, Music, and Theater — rather than counted as a number of ensembles.
strings.t: Yo òganize pwogram lan otou twa pilye — Visual Arts, Music, ak Theater — olye yo konte l kòm yon kantite ansanm.

strings.t: 40+ kou atistik opsyonèl atravè kat domèn — yon minimòm deklare olye yon dekont katalòg egzak.

strings.text: Eight vocal and instrumental groups across Middle and Upper School, spanning auditioned honors ensembles and open-enrollment groups.
strings.t: Uit gwoup vokal ak enstrimantal atravè Middle ak Upper School, ki kouvri ansanm onè ak odisyon ak gwoup enskripsyon lib.

strings.text: Nine named ensembles across the divisions — CDS Children’s Choir (3–5), MS Band, MS Choir, MS Worship Band, Symphonic Band, HS Choir, HS Worship Band, HS A Cappella, and the grade-5 intro ensembles — plus a Tri-M Music Honor Society chapter. Worship bands at both MS and HS are the distinctive rung.
strings.t: Nèf ansanm ki nonmen atravè divizyon yo — CDS Children’s Choir (3–5), MS Band, MS Choir, MS Worship Band, Symphonic Band, HS Choir, HS Worship Band, HS A Cappella, ak ansanm entwodiksyon grad 5 yo — plis yon chapit Tri-M Music Honor Society. Worship band nan MS ak HS se echèl ki distenk lan.

strings.t: Kat ansanm pèfòmans: Band, Orchestra, Chorus, ak Jazz.

strings.t: Twa ansanm lekòl segondè ki gen non — Concert Band, Jazz Band ak Choir. Yo pa ofri okenn òkès nan okenn nivo.

strings.t: Klib, sosyete onè, ak òganizasyon elèv dirije nan Upper School la. Chak lekòl konte diferan — pase sou yon chif pou wè sa li genyen ladan l.

strings.text: Counted from the clubs directory's raw HTML across its six categories — Education 16, Service 23, Community 9, Culture 4, Sports 15, General Interest 9. The school profile separately says 'over 50 club opportunities', a round prose figure rather than a count.
strings.t: Konte apati HTML brit anyè klib la atravè sis kategori li yo — Education 16, Service 23, Community 9, Culture 4, Sports 15, General Interest 9. Pwofil lekòl la di apa “over 50 club opportunities”, yon chif won nan pwoz olye ke yon dekont.

strings.text: Cannon publishes no chartered club directory, so this is a documented floor: 8 named Upper School organizations plus its 12 Upper School honor societies. The live roster shifts year to year and is not fully disclosed.
strings.t: Cannon pa pibliye okenn anyè klib ofisyèl, konsa sa a se yon minimòm dokimante: 8 òganizasyon Upper School ki gen non plis 12 sosyete onè Upper School li yo. Lis aktif la chanje ane an ane epi li pa devwale konplètman.

strings.text: Counts the 23 named organizations in the Upper School across four categories. The school also reports 35 across JK–12; only the Upper School band is used here for a like-for-like comparison.
strings.t: Konte 23 òganizasyon ki gen non nan Upper School la atravè kat kategori. Lekòl la rapòte tou 35 atravè JK–12; se sèlman bann Upper School la yo itilize isit la pou yon konparezon egal-a-egal.

strings.text: The school publishes a range rather than a list — its Upper School page cites “nearly 50 clubs” and the 2025–26 profile lists “45 different clubs and activities.” Only 7 are confirmed by name in public sources.
strings.t: Lekòl la pibliye yon entèval olye yon lis — paj Upper School li a site “nearly 50 clubs” epi pwofil 2025–26 la liste “45 different clubs and activities.” Se sèlman 7 ki konfime pa non nan sous piblik.

strings.text: Covenant Day publishes no club directory of its own, so this is a documented floor: 14 Upper School organizations and honor societies confirmed across school pages and a third-party roster, after filtering out Middle/Lower School entries, paid lesson programs, and curricular ensembles.
strings.t: Covenant Day pa pibliye okenn anyè klèb pa li, kidonk sa a se yon planche dokimante: 14 òganizasyon ak sosyete onè Upper School konfime atravè paj lekòl yo ak yon lis twazyèm pati, apre yo fin filtre antre Middle/Lower School yo, pwogram leson ki peye yo, ak ansanm kourikoulòm yo.

strings.text: Davidson Day publishes no Upper School club roster, so this counts only the clubs confirmed in public sources — a documented floor, not a total.
strings.t: Davidson Day pa pibliye okenn lis klib Upper School, konsa sa a konte sèlman klib ki konfime nan sous piblik yo — yon minimòm dokimante, se pa yon total.

strings.t: Pran nan lis klib Upper School ofisyèl 2025–26 lekòl la, ak 5 klib atistik eskli pou yon dekont pwòp — pi bon seri a nan ansanm nan.

strings.text: Standing high-school student organizations: National Honor Society, National Beta Club, Spanish Honor Society, Student Council, and the Timothy Project. Clubs are otherwise student-initiated by application, so no fixed roster is published.
strings.t: Òganizasyon elèv lekòl segondè pèmanan: National Honor Society, National Beta Club, Spanish Honor Society, Student Council, ak Timothy Project la. Apa de sa, se elèv yo ki inisye klib yo pa aplikasyon, kidonk pa gen okenn lis fiks ki pibliye.

strings.text: 27 non-sports organizations (18 clubs/organizations + 9 arts/music) from a single aggregator (PrivateSchoolReview) — the school's own site has no clubs page, so this is a single-source count. Five are honor societies; a subset (Choir, Drama, Jazz Band, Discipleship) is corroborated on the school site.
strings.t: 27 òganizasyon ki pa espò (18 klib/òganizasyon + 9 atizay/mizik) ki soti nan yon sèl agregatè (PrivateSchoolReview) — pwòp sit lekòl la pa gen paj klib, kidonk sa a se yon kont ak yon sèl sous. Senk se sosyete onè; sit lekòl la konfime yon pati ladan (Choir, Drama, Jazz Band, Discipleship).

strings.text: The iGEM gold medal is the school's strongest published competitive result — iGEM is a university-level synthetic-biology competition with a high-school track, and Gaston Day fielded teams in 2012, 2016, 2018 and 2020. The VEX Robotics team separately qualified for TSA VEX Nationals in 2023, its first year competing. The medal level is third-party-confirmed; the archived iGEM wikis 403 to automated fetches.

Ekip VEX Robotics la te kalifye apa pou TSA VEX Nationals an 2023, premye ane li t ap konpetisyone. Nivo meday la konfime pa yon twazyèm pati; wiki iGEM achive yo bay 403 pou rekipere otomatik.

strings.t: Ekip robotik Brainy Yaks la te fini nan top 100 nan plis pase 32,000 ekip nan FIRST LEGO League World Championship, de ane youn dèyè lòt (2024 ak 2025).

strings.t: Ekip Chess Middle School la te fè 2yèm plas nan yon tounwa — rezilta klib konpetitif ki pi remakab nòt lekòl la dokimante.

strings.text: The Model UN team earned 6 awards at the MUNCH 2025 conference, including 4 Outstanding Delegate honors.
strings.t: Ekip Model UN la te genyen 6 prim nan konferans MUNCH 2025 la, ki gen ladan 4 onè Outstanding Delegate.

strings.text: The debate program was named to the NSDA Schools of Excellence — a top-20 ranking nationally.
strings.t: Yo te nonmen pwogram deba a nan NSDA Schools of Excellence — yon klasman top-20 nan tout peyi a.

strings.text: Cornelia Knight of the Covenant Day Blue Mock Trial team won the NC Mock Trial courtroom-artist regional (Hickory) and was the 2025 State Champion Courtroom Artist runner-up — the program’s best-documented statewide result.
strings.t: Cornelia Knight nan ekip Mock Trial Covenant Day Blue a te genyen rejyonal atis tribinal NC Mock Trial la (Hickory) epi li te dezyèm pou State Champion Courtroom Artist an 2025 — rezilta pwogram nan ki pi byen dokimante nan tout eta a.

strings.t: Ekip Battle of the Books Middle School la te fè 1ye plas nan konpetisyon rejyonal li a.

strings.t: Ekip biznis DECA a te avanse nan International Career Development Conference (ICDC) nasyonal la nan 2026.

strings.text: The 2022 NCISAA 4A boys basketball state title (def. Greensboro Day 71–66; Cade Tyson scored 31). The girls soccer team reached the 2026 4A final as runner-up.
strings.t: Tit eta basketball gason NCISAA 4A 2022 la (bat Greensboro Day 71–66; Cade Tyson te fè 31). Ekip soccer fi a te rive nan final 4A 2026 la kòm dezyèm plas.

strings.text: 6:00 PM is from the school's own 2025-26 Schedule of Tuition and Fees (Lower School 3:00–6:00, Middle School 4:00–6:00). The After School Program web page states 5:30 PM for both divisions — the two school sources disagree, and a family should confirm the current window.
strings.t: 6:00 PM soti nan pwòp Schedule of Tuition and Fees 2025-26 lekòl la (Lower School 3:00–6:00, Middle School 4:00–6:00). Paj entènèt After School Program lan di 5:30 PM pou toude divizyon yo — de sous lekòl la pa dakò, epi yon fanmi ta dwe konfime fenèt aktyèl la.

strings.text: The JrK–8 After School Program runs 3:00–6:00 p.m. on regular days. On early-dismissal days it runs 11:45 a.m.–4:00 p.m., ending two hours earlier than the 6:00 shown here.
strings.t: After School Program JrK–8 la fonksyone 3:00–6:00 p.m. nan jou nòmal yo. Nan jou lekòl lage bonè, li fonksyone 11:45 a.m.–4:00 p.m., li fini de èdtan pi bonè pase 6:00 ki make isit la.

strings.text: 6:00 p.m. is the Lower School figure: Extended Day (JK–4) runs from dismissal to 6:00 p.m., and the school states that all Extended Day care ends promptly at 6 p.m. Middle School (grades 5–8) is a separate programme that ends at 5:00 p.m., a full hour earlier, with its own late fee from 5:01 p.m. This is the only school on the roster whose divisions differ, so read this row as Lower School and confirm Middle School hours separately.
strings.t: 6:00 p.m. se chif Lower School la: Extended Day (JK–4) ale depi lè lekòl kase jiska 6:00 p.m., epi lekòl la di tout swen Extended Day fini egzakteman a 6 p.m. Middle School (klas 5–8) se yon pwogram apa ki fini a 5:00 p.m., yon èdtan pi bonè, ak pwòp frè reta pa l depi 5:01 p.m. Se sèl lekòl nan lis la kote divizyon yo diferan, kidonk li ranje sa a kòm Lower School epi konfime orè Middle School la apa.

strings.text: The Lower School’s Structured Care program runs until 6:00 p.m. Confirm current hours with the school.
strings.t: Pwogram Structured Care Lower School la ale jiska 6:00 p.m. Konfime lè aktyèl yo ak lekòl la.

strings.text: Extended Day closes at 6:00 p.m. for every grade it serves — TK from 1:00, Kindergarten from 2:00, grades 1–5 from 3:00 — and the Middle School Clubhouse also runs to 6:00. Upper School has no published after-school programme. Late pickup is billed at $1.00 per minute after 6:00 p.m.
strings.t: Extended Day fèmen a 6:00 p.m. pou tout klas li sèvi yo — TK depi 1:00, Kindergarten depi 2:00, klas 1–5 depi 3:00 — epi Middle School Clubhouse la ale jiska 6:00 tou. Upper School pa gen okenn pwogram apre lekòl ki pibliye. Yo faktire reta nan vin chèche a $1.00 pa minit apre 6:00 p.m.

strings.text: The Lower School’s Hawks’ Club aftercare runs 1:30–6:00 p.m. Confirm current hours with the school.
strings.t: Aprè-lekòl Hawks’ Club Lower School la ale 1:30–6:00 p.m. Konfime lè aktyèl yo ak lekòl la.

strings.text: The JK–8 Extended Day program’s last session runs 4:30–6:00 p.m., and free before-care starts at 7:30 a.m. Confirm current hours with the school.
strings.t: Dènye sesyon pwogram Extended Day JK–8 la woule 4:30–6:00 p.m., epi gadri gratis anvan lekòl kòmanse 7:30 a.m. Konfime lè aktyèl yo ak lekòl la.

strings.text: The Lower School’s Extended Care runs 2:45–6:00 p.m. Confirm current hours with the school.
strings.t: Extended Care Lower School la ale 2:45–6:00 p.m. Konfime lè aktyèl yo ak lekòl la.

strings.text: After School / After YCC care runs 3:00–6:00 PM; 6:00 PM is the latest published pickup.
strings.t: Swen After School / After YCC ale 3:00–6:00 PM; 6:00 PM se dènye lè pou vin chèche ki pibliye.

strings.text: The Afterschool program (TK–5) and Study Hall (grades 6–11) share one 2:30–5:30 p.m. window, so 5:30 p.m. is the latest pickup — earlier than the 6:00 p.m. the other schools offer.
strings.t: Pwogram Afterschool la (TK–5) ak Study Hall la (grad 6–11) pataje yon sèl fenèt 2:30–5:30 p.m., kidonk 5:30 p.m. se dènye lè pou vin chèche timoun nan — pi bonè pase 6:00 p.m. lòt lekòl yo ofri a.

strings.text: Cost of after-school care
strings.t: Konbyen gadri apre lekòl koute

strings.text: The most expensive published arrangement: the highest-priced grade band, at the latest pickup tier, five days a week. Each cell shows a monthly cost with the year’s total beneath it. The schools bill in different periods — monthly, per semester, annually — so a ≈ marks the figure we converted rather than the one that school publishes, assuming a 10-month school year. Read the per-cell notes before comparing. 2026–27 rates, except Cannon’s 2025–26.
strings.t: Fòmil ki pi chè yo pibliye a: gwoup klas ki pi chè a, nan lè ranmasaj ki pi ta a, senk jou pa semèn. Chak kaz montre yon pri chak mwa ak total ane a anba li. Lekòl yo fakture sou peryòd diferan — chak mwa, chak semès, chak ane — kidonk siy ≈ la make chif nou menm nou konvèti a, pa sa lekòl la pibliye, sou baz yon ane lekòl 10 mwa. Li nòt chak kaz anvan ou konpare. Tarif 2026–27, eksepte sa Cannon yo, ki se 2025–26.

strings.text: $95/week is the Lower School (PS–4th) rate on the 2025-26 fee schedule; Middle School (5th–8th) is $55/week. Drop-in is $30/day and $15/day respectively. The programme web page labels the recurring figures as $100 and $60 per MONTH — the weekly reading is used because a monthly rate below four drop-in days is not coherent.
strings.t: $95/semèn se to Lower School (PS–4th) sou orè frè 2025-26 la; Middle School (5th–8th) se $55/semèn. Vini yon jou konsa se $30/jou ak $15/jou respektivman. Paj entènèt pwogram nan make chif ki repete yo kòm $100 ak $60 pa MWA — lekti pa semèn nan sèvi paske yon to mansyèl ki pi ba pase kat jou vini konsa pa gen sans.

strings.text: Cannon publishes one annual price, $3,784 — the monthly figure above is that spread over 10 months, not a rate the school quotes. It buys the JrK–8 After School Program, 3:00–6:00 p.m. (3 hours) five days a week, at 2025–26 rates: the only school here not on 2026–27, because the page carrying the rate card is no longer publicly linked.
strings.t: Cannon pibliye yon sèl pri anyèl, $3,784 — chif chak mwa anwo a se montan sa a separe sou 10 mwa, se pa yon tarif lekòl la bay. Li kouvri After School Program JrK–8 la, 3:00–6:00 p.m. (3 èdtan), senk jou pa semèn, ak tarif 2025–26: se sèl lekòl isit la ki pa sou 2026–27, paske paj ki gen lis pri a pa gen lyen piblik ankò.

strings.text: JK–Grade 4 Extended Day to 6:00 p.m., five days a week, billed monthly at $325 for 2026–27; the yearly total assumes 10 billing months. Rates rose 32–52% over 2024–25, and Middle School is not in this figure because it bills by the hour ($8/hr, ending at 5:00 p.m.).
strings.t: Extended Day depi JK rive klas 4 jiska 6:00 p.m., senk jou pa semèn, fakture chak mwa a $325 pou 2026–27; total ane a sipoze 10 mwa faktirasyon. Tarif yo monte 32–52% depi 2024–25, epi Middle School pa ladan chif sa a paske li fakture pa èdtan ($8/èdtan, jiska 5:00 p.m.).

strings.text: Junior Kindergarten at the 6:00 p.m. tier, five days a week, billed monthly at $900 — the yearly total assumes 10 months, which the school does not publish. JK dismisses at 1:15 p.m., so this buys roughly 4.75 hours a day; Grades 1–4 at the same 6:00 p.m. tier is $610/mo.
strings.t: Junior Kindergarten nan lè 6:00 p.m. la, senk jou pa semèn, fakture chak mwa a $900 — total ane a sipoze 10 mwa, yon bagay lekòl la pa pibliye. JK lage 1:15 p.m., kidonk sa kouvri anviwon 4.75 èdtan pa jou; klas 1–4 nan menm lè 6:00 p.m. la se $610/mwa.

strings.text: Latin bills per semester, $4,650 twice a year — the monthly figure above is that $9,300 spread over 10 months, not a rate the school quotes. It covers TK/K at the 1:30–6:00 p.m. tier five days a week; TK and Kindergarten dismiss at 1:30 p.m., so this buys 4.5 hours a day, more than any figure beside it. Grades 1–5 at their 2:55–6:00 p.m. tier is $3,000 a semester.
strings.t: Latin fakture pa semès, $4,650 de fwa pa ane — chif chak mwa anwo a se $9,300 sa a separe sou 10 mwa, se pa yon tarif lekòl la bay. Li kouvri TK/K nan lè 1:30–6:00 p.m. la senk jou pa semèn; TK ak Kindergarten lage 1:30 p.m., kidonk sa kouvri 4.5 èdtan pa jou, plis pase nenpòt chif akote l. Klas 1–5 nan lè 2:55–6:00 p.m. pa yo se $3,000 pa semès.

strings.text: Covenant Day prices per 1.5-hour session ($248/month for five days a week): a JK/K child dismissed at 1:30 p.m. needs all three sessions to reach 6:00, i.e. $744/month. The yearly figure is the school’s own "for 10 Months" table ($6,696), cheaper than 10× the monthly rate because August and December bill at half. Grades 1–8 dismiss around 3:00 and need only two sessions ($496/month); before-care from 7:30 a.m. is free.
strings.t: Covenant Day mete pri pa sesyon 1.5 èdtan ($248/mwa pou senk jou pa semèn): yon timoun JK/K yo lage 1:30 p.m. bezwen tou lè twa sesyon yo pou rive 6:00, sa vle di $744/mwa. Chif anyèl la se tab "for 10 Months" lekòl la li menm ($6,696), pi bon mache pase 10× to mansyèl la paske Out ak Desanm faktire a mwatye. Grad 1–8 lage anviwon 3:00 epi bezwen sèlman de sesyon ($496/mwa); gadri anvan lekòl apati 7:30 a.m. gratis.

strings.text: Carmel Christian publishes one flat After School / After YCC rate — $245/month for five days a week, 3:00–6:00 p.m. — the same for every grade, unlike the tiered-by-grade schools beside it. The yearly total spreads it over the nine billing months the handbook states; before-care from 7:30 a.m. is $110/month, and there is a $30/day drop-in.
strings.t: Carmel Christian pibliye yon sèl to fiks After School / After YCC — $245/mwa pou senk jou pa semèn, 3:00–6:00 p.m. — menm bagay pou chak klas, kontrèman ak lekòl ki gen palye pa klas ki bò kote l yo. Total anyèl la separe l sou nèf mwa faktirasyon handbook la deklare; swen anvan lekòl apati 7:30 a.m. se $110/mwa, epi gen yon opsyon san randevou $30/jou.

strings.text: Transitional Kindergarten at the 1–6 p.m. tier, five days a week, billed monthly at $750; the yearly total assumes 10 months, and the school states outright that its number of billing months is not published. TK dismisses at 1:00 p.m., so this covers 5 hours a day; Grades 1–5 at 3–6 p.m. is $470/mo, and there is no drop-in option.
strings.t: Transitional Kindergarten nan lè 1–6 p.m. la, senk jou pa semèn, fakture chak mwa a $750; total ane a sipoze 10 mwa, epi lekòl la di klè li pa pibliye konbyen mwa li fakture. TK lage 1:00 p.m., kidonk sa kouvri 5 èdtan pa jou; klas 1–5 depi 3 rive 6 p.m. se $470/mwa, epi pa gen opsyon vini yon jou konsa.

strings.text: Weeks of summer camp
strings.t: Semèn kan ete

strings.text: Number of camp weeks the school runs in summer 2026, counting shortened holiday weeks. A longer season is more weeks a family can cover.
strings.t: Kantite semèn kan lekòl la fè nan ete 2026 la, ansanm ak semèn ki pi kout akòz jou fèt. Yon sezon ki pi long se plis semèn yon fanmi ka kouvri.

strings.text: Four distinct camp windows across June and July, every one a half-day block. CCHS runs no continuous multi-week summer season and no academic summer school — its handbook states a failing student retakes the course externally, at their own expense.
strings.t: Kat peryòd kan distenk atravè jen ak jiyè, chak nan yo yon blòk demi-jounen. CCHS pa gen okenn sezon ete kontinyèl plizyè semèn ni okenn lekòl ete akademik — manyèl li a di yon elèv ki echwe reprann kou a deyò, sou pwòp depans li.

strings.text: Eight weeks including the June 1-5 "Pre-Camp" week, which carries 9 priced camps. The school’s own summer landing page markets the season as the seven weeks from June 8.
strings.t: Uit semèn, ansanm ak semèn “Pre-Camp” 1-5 jen an, ki gen 9 kan ki gen pri. Paj ete lekòl la li menm prezante sezon an kòm sèt semèn ki kòmanse 8 jen.

strings.text: The live 2026 page shows eight session windows (Jun–Jul), consistent with the ~8 week-blocks of the Summer 2023 catalog recovered from the Internet Archive; the exact 2026 camp names are hidden behind the school's registration platform.
strings.t: Paj 2026 an dirèk la montre uit fenèt sesyon (Jen–Jiyè), ki dakò ak ~8 blòk semèn katalòg Summer 2023 la yo rekipere nan Internet Archive; non egzak kan 2026 yo kache dèyè platfòm enskripsyon lekòl la.

strings.text: Six weeks, but not consecutive: the school takes a two-week break around July 4 (June 29 – July 3 has no camps).
strings.t: Sis semèn, men yo pa youn dèyè lòt: lekòl la pran yon poz de semèn otou 4 jiyè (pa gen kan soti 29 jen rive 3 jiyè).

strings.text: Eight camp weeks between June 1 and July 31, not consecutive — the week of June 29 has no camps.
strings.t: Uit semèn kan ant 1ye jen ak 31 jiyè, pa youn dèyè lòt — semèn 29 jen an pa gen kan.

strings.text: Camps published
strings.t: Kan ki pibliye

strings.text: Camp offerings in the school’s own 2026 catalog. Counting conventions differ — most schools count each week a camp runs as a separate row — so read the per-cell notes before comparing.
strings.t: Kan lekòl la ofri nan katalòg 2026 pa l la. Konvansyon konte yo diferan — pifò lekòl konte chak semèn yon kan ap fèt kòm yon liy apa — kidonk li nòt chak selil anvan ou konpare.

strings.text: Cougar Basketball, Eddie Hull Baseball, Cougar Football and Just4Kicks Soccer. Notre Dame Vision and the Mayor's Youth Employment Program are hosted by others and are not counted as CCHS camps.
strings.t: Cougar Basketball, Eddie Hull Baseball, Cougar Football ak Just4Kicks Soccer. Se lòt moun ki òganize Notre Dame Vision ak Mayor’s Youth Employment Program epi nou pa konte yo kòm kan CCHS.

strings.text: 251 camp-week offerings across seven weeks, representing roughly 180 distinct camp titles. Counted from the school’s own 80-page 2026 brochure.
strings.t: 251 òf kan-semèn sou sèt semèn, ki reprezante anviwon 180 tit kan diferan. Konte apati bwochi 2026 lekòl la li menm ki gen 80 paj.

strings.text: 17 named camps in the Summer 2023 catalog — 12 academic/enrichment and 5 athletic — recovered from the Internet Archive because the live 2026 catalog is hidden behind the school's registration platform. A representative slate, not the exact 2026 list.
strings.t: 17 kan ki gen non nan katalòg Summer 2023 la — 12 akademik/anrichisman ak 5 atletik — rekipere nan Internet Archive paske katalòg 2026 an dirèk la kache dèyè platfòm enskripsyon lekòl la. Yon seri reprezantatif, se pa lis 2026 egzak la.

strings.text: 232 offerings across seven sessions, from 169 unique camp titles — a camp running in three sessions is counted three times.
strings.t: 232 òf sou sèt sesyon, ki soti nan 169 tit kan inik — yon kan k ap fèt nan twa sesyon konte twa fwa.

strings.text: 170 priced rows in the 2026 brochure, covering 151 distinct camp names and 231 total camp-session offerings.
strings.t: 170 liy ki gen pri nan bwochi 2026 la, ki kouvri 151 non kan diferan ak 231 òf kan-sesyon antou.

strings.text: 132 priced rows, roughly 85 distinct camp titles. The school separately markets the program as "over 150 exciting camp options", a figure its public listing does not itemize.
strings.t: 132 liy ki gen pri, anviwon 85 tit kan diferan. Anplis, lekòl la prezante pwogram nan kòm “plis pase 150 opsyon kan pasyonan”, yon chif lis piblik li a pa detaye.

strings.text: 133 half-day sessions across six weeks, roughly 96 distinct camps. Every one is a three-hour half-day — the school publishes no full-day camp.
strings.t: 133 sesyon demi-jounen sou sis semèn, anviwon 96 kan diferan. Tout se demi-jounen twa èdtan — lekòl la pa pibliye okenn kan jounen antye.

strings.text: 20 distinct camps named on the public 2026 page — a per-camp count, not the per-week session count most schools beside it publish. The school separately markets "29 camps"; per-week variants and portal-only offerings likely account for the difference.
strings.t: 20 kan distenk yo nonmen sou paj piblik 2026 la — yon dekont pa kan, se pa dekont sesyon pa semèn pifò lekòl akote li yo pibliye. Lekòl la mache separeman "29 kan"; varyant pa semèn ak òf ki nan pòtal sèlman gen dwa esplike diferans lan.

strings.text: These are community youth camps that CCHS athletics hosts, not summer programming for its own students. Campers are rising 2nd-9th graders aged 6-13 — younger than the 9-12 school running them, which is why the band sits below the school's own grade span.
strings.t: Sa yo se kan kominotè pou jèn depatman atletik CCHS òganize, se pa pwogram ete pou pwòp elèv li yo. Patisipan yo se elèv k ap monte nan 2yèm-9yèm ane ki gen 6-13 an — pi jèn pase lekòl 9-12 k ap òganize yo a, se poutèt sa bann nan chita anba pwòp entèval nivo lekòl la.

strings.text: Camp Spartan Jr takes rising PK–K and Camp Spartan rising 1st–5th; half-day enrichment camps span rising PreK–6th; summer tutoring runs to rising 12th. Nike Sports Camps are advertised by age (8–17) rather than by grade.
strings.t: Camp Spartan Jr pran timoun k ap monte nan PK–K epi Camp Spartan sa yo k ap monte nan 1ye–5yèm; kan anrichisman demi-jounen yo kouvri sa yo k ap monte nan PreK–6yèm; leson patikilye ete a rive jiska sa yo k ap monte nan 12yèm. Nike Sports Camps yo anonse pa laj (8–17) olye ke pa grad.

strings.text: The school states camps are "open to all campers ages 3.5 - 18 years old". Age is calculated as of August 1, 2026, and all Pre-K campers must be toilet trained.
strings.t: Lekòl la di kan yo “ouvè pou tout patisipan ki gen 3.5 - 18 an”. Laj la kalkile jan li ye 1ye out 2026, epi tout patisipan Pre-K yo dwe konn al nan twalèt pou kont yo.

strings.text: The brochure says campers must be "at least four years old by January 1, 2026"; the About page states ages 4.5 to 18. Both are the school’s own wording.
strings.t: Bwochi a di patisipan yo dwe gen “otan mwens kat an anvan 1ye janvye 2026”; paj About la di laj 4.5 rive 18. Toude se pwòp mo lekòl la.

strings.text: The listing’s lowest published band is Age 4. The school’s own pages disagree on the floor — the summer page says ages 4–18, the after-school page says 3–18.
strings.t: Bann ki pi ba lis la pibliye se Laj 4. Pwòp paj lekòl la pa dakò sou limit ki pi ba a — paj ete a di laj 4–18, paj apre lekòl la di 3–18.

strings.text: Grades are rising 2026-27. JK campers must have turned 4 by February 1, 2026.
strings.t: Klas yo se sa yo pral fè an 2026-27. Patisipan JK yo dwe gentan gen 4 an anvan 1ye fevriye 2026.

strings.text: The school states Camp Cannon is "open to all children ages 4 to 18". Campers must be fully potty trained, and only camps matching a child’s age appear during online registration.
strings.t: Lekòl la di Camp Cannon “ouvè pou tout timoun ki gen 4 rive 18 an”. Patisipan yo dwe konn al nan twalèt nèt pou kont yo, epi se sèlman kan ki koresponn ak laj timoun nan ki parèt pandan enskripsyon an liy.

strings.text: Grades are rising grades for the coming school year, from Little Lion/Cub Camp at the bottom through high-school strength-and-conditioning and college-admissions camps. Camps are open to the community.
strings.t: Grad yo se grad k ap monte pou ane eskolè k ap vini an, depi Little Lion/Cub Camp anba a jiska kan fòs-ak-kondisyone lekòl segondè ak kan admisyon inivèsite. Kan yo louvri pou kominote a.

strings.text: Summer Adventures serves rising kindergarten through rising 8th grade; individual camps carry narrower bands.
strings.t: Summer Adventures sèvi depi rising kindergarten rive rising 8yèm klas; kan endividyèl yo pote bann pi etwat.

strings.text: The great majority of camps serve rising 1st–8th graders, plus one high-school camp (a College Admissions Boot Camp for rising juniors and seniors). From the Summer 2023 catalog, recovered from the Internet Archive.
strings.t: Gwo majorite kan yo sèvi elèv rising 1ye–8yèm klas, plis yon kan lekòl segondè (yon College Admissions Boot Camp pou elèv rising twazyèm ak dènye ane). Apati katalòg Summer 2023 la, rekipere nan Internet Archive.

strings.text: Wrap-around care
strings.t: Swen anvan ak apre kan

strings.text: Earliest drop-off to latest pickup with the school’s paid before- and after-care options — the real outer limit of a camp day for a working family.
strings.t: Depi lè ki pi bonè pou depoze pitit la jiska lè ki pi ta pou vin chèche l ak opsyon swen anvan ak apre kan lekòl la fè peye — vrè limit yon jounen kan pou yon fanmi k ap travay.

strings.text: Before Camp Care runs 7:45–8:30 AM at $25/week and After Camp Care 3:30–5:00 PM at $35/week, both registered separately from the camps. A Between Camp Lunch Care block (11:30 AM–12:30 PM, $40/week) is REQUIRED for campers staying on campus between a morning and an afternoon camp.
strings.t: Before Camp Care fèt 7:45–8:30 AM pou $25/semèn epi After Camp Care 3:30–5:00 PM pou $35/semèn, toude enskri apa de kan yo. Yon blòk Between Camp Lunch Care (11:30 AM–12:30 PM, $40/semèn) OBLIGATWA pou patisipan ki rete sou kanpis la ant yon kan maten ak yon kan apremidi.

strings.text: An eleven-hour span, the widest of the five — Before Care from 7am and After Care to 6pm, both $120/week, or $220/week bundled as Complete Care.
strings.t: Yon etandi onz èdtan, ki pi laj nan senk yo — Before Care depi 7am ak After Care jiska 6pm, toude $120/semèn, oswa $220/semèn ansanm kòm Complete Care.

strings.text: A nine-hour span. Because every camp is a half-day, covering a full working day means registering a morning AND an afternoon camp; the noon–1 p.m. bridge care between them is free.
strings.t: Yon etandi nèf èdtan. Paske chak kan se demi-jounen, pou kouvri yon jounen travay konplè fòk ou enskri pitit la nan yon kan maten AK yon kan apremidi; swen pon ki nan mitan an, midi–1 p.m., gratis.

strings.text: A ten-hour span: Before Care from 7:30 am at $50/week and After Care to 5:30 pm at $60/week, or $90/week for both. Camp itself runs 9:00–4:00.
strings.t: Yon etandi dis èdtan: Before Care depi 7:30 am pou $50/semèn ak After Care jiska 5:30 pm pou $60/semèn, oswa $90/semèn pou toude. Kan an li menm fèt 9:00–4:00.

strings.text: A ten-hour span. Before Care runs 7:30–8:15 am ($70.00/week) and After Care to 5:30 pm ($150.00/week); the Super Care bundle is $195.00/week. Late pick-up is $25.00 every 15 minutes.
strings.t: Yon etandi dis èdtan. Before Care fèt 7:30–8:15 am ($70.00/semèn) epi After Care jiska 5:30 pm ($150.00/semèn); pakè Super Care la se $195.00/semèn. Vin chèche an reta koute $25.00 chak 15 minit.

strings.text: A nine-and-a-half-hour span: Morning Care from 7:30 am ($105/week) and Afternoon Care to 5 pm ($85/week), or $160/week bundled as Super Care. Late pick-up is $1/minute after 5 pm.
strings.t: Yon etandi nèf èdtan edmi: Morning Care depi 7:30 am ($105/semèn) ak Afternoon Care jiska 5 pm ($85/semèn), oswa $160/semèn ansanm kòm Super Care. Vin chèche an reta koute $1/minit apre 5 pm.

strings.text: A ten-hour span for TK–8: Before Care 7:30–8:45 am at $50/week and After Care 4:00–5:30 pm at $50/week, with $30/week Lunch Care bridging noon–1 pm. Camp Lion (Full Day) and Cub Camp include all three at no extra cost.
strings.t: Yon dire dis èdtan pou TK–8: Before Care 7:30–8:45 am a $50/semèn ak After Care 4:00–5:30 pm a $50/semèn, ak Lunch Care $30/semèn ki fè pon ant midi–1 pm. Camp Lion (Full Day) ak Cub Camp gen ladan tou le twa san okenn frè anplis.

strings.text: Wrap-around care is limited to the 12–1 PM After Camp Lunch Hour add-on; no before-camp or full-day care is published.
strings.t: Swen pwolonje a limite ak sèvis anplis After Camp Lunch Hour 12–1 PM la; pa gen okenn swen anvan kan ni tout lajounen ki pibliye.

strings.t: Angajman Power 4

strings.text: Distinct athletes committed to an SEC / Big Ten / ACC / Big 12 program, Classes of 2024–2026. Documented minimum.
strings.t: Atlèt diferan ki angaje nan yon pwogram SEC / Big Ten / ACC / Big 12, Klas 2024–2026. Minimòm dokimante.

strings.text: Fifteen Power Four commitments across the Classes of 2024-2026, from the school’s signing articles, newspaper signing lists and the colleges’ own rosters. A documented minimum: CCHS publishes no consolidated signing list.
strings.t: Kenz angajman Power Four atravè Klas 2024-2026 yo, ki soti nan atik siyati lekòl la, nan lis siyati jounal yo ak nan pwòp lis jwè inivèsite yo. Yon minimòm dokimante: CCHS pa pibliye okenn lis siyati konsolide.

strings.text: A documented minimum: Cannon publishes no signing list, so these athletes were confirmed on college rosters and recruiting services. Several of Cannon’s best-known athletes committed outside the 2024–26 window and so are not counted here.
strings.t: Yon minimòm dokimante: Cannon pa pibliye okenn lis siyati, kidonk atlèt sa yo te konfime sou lis ekip inivèsite yo ak nan sèvis rekritman yo. Plizyè nan atlèt Cannon ki pi popilè yo te angaje deyò fenèt 2024–26 la epi konsa yo pa konte isit la.

strings.text: A documented minimum: the school’s public commitment list runs through 2025, so its Class of 2026 is confirmed from college rosters and the school’s own announcements.
strings.t: Yon minimòm dokimante: lis angajman piblik lekòl la ale jiska 2025, kidonk Class of 2026 li a konfime apati lis jwè inivèsite yo ak pwòp anons lekòl la.

strings.text: A documented minimum. Charlotte Latin names every signee from its three yearly signing events; its academically heavy classes send many athletes to Division III.
strings.t: Yon minimòm dokimante. Charlotte Latin nonmen chak atlèt ki siyen nan twa evènman siyati li fè chak ane; klas akademik lou li yo voye anpil atlèt nan Division III.

strings.text: A documented minimum: Emily Eaton (’24) signed with Louisville field hockey, an ACC program, and started every game as a freshman. The Class of 2024’s spring signing article is only partially recoverable, so earlier 2024 commits may be missing.
strings.t: Yon minimòm dokimante: Emily Eaton (’24) te siyen ak field hockey Louisville, yon pwogram ACC, epi li te kòmanse chak match kòm yon freshman. Atik siyati prentan Class of 2024 la sèlman ka rekipere an pati, kidonk angajman 2024 pi bonè yo ka manke.

strings.text: A documented minimum. Davidson Day published no signing list for the Class of 2024, which is counted from college rosters; the Classes of 2025 and 2026 come from the school’s own published lists.
strings.t: Yon minimòm dokimante. Davidson Day pa t pibliye okenn lis siyati pou klas 2024 la, ki konte apati lis ekip inivèsite yo; klas 2025 ak 2026 yo soti nan lis lekòl la li menm pibliye.

strings.t: Angajman Division I

strings.text: Distinct athletes committed to any NCAA Division I program, Classes of 2024–2026 (includes the Power 4 count above). Documented minimum.
